title: Oracle Analytics Failures by Dashboard
app: Oracle Analytics Server/Cloud usage tracking and audit via DB Connect and BI Server logs via UF.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=oracle:analytics:usage success="0"
| stats count as failures, latest(_time) as last_failure by dashboard_name
| where failures>0
| sort - failures
description: Counts Oracle Analytics failures grouped by dashboard so operators immediately see which specific dashboards are broken rather than a single global failure number.
value: Object-level failure attribution turns a vague 'Oracle Analytics is failing' alert into an actionable list of exactly what to fix first.
implementation: Ingest Oracle Analytics failure events; schedule every 15 minutes and alert on failures for business-critical dashboards.
visualization: Table of dashboard by failure count and last failure time.
grandmaExplanation: We tell you exactly which parts of Oracle Analytics are failing, not just that something is wrong, so the right thing gets fixed first.
